---
title: "UK Parliament petitions"
subtitle: "Open petitions and how close each is to a threshold"
---

At **10,000** signatures the government must respond. At **100,000** the petition is
considered for a debate in Parliament.

```{python}
import duckdb
import plotly.express as px
from IPython.display import Markdown, HTML

con = duckdb.connect("../data/warehouse.duckdb", read_only=True)
df = con.sql("select * from main.fct_petitions").df()
con.close()

df["short_title"] = df["title"].str.slice(0, 70).where(df["title"].str.len() <= 70,
                                                       df["title"].str.slice(0, 67) + "…")
BLUE = "#2a78d6"
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
total = len(df)
over_10k = (df["signatures"] >= 10_000).sum()
over_100k = (df["signatures"] >= 100_000).sum()
print(f"**{total:,}** open petitions loaded · **{over_10k:,}** past 10,000 · **{over_100k:,}** past 100,000")
```

## Closest to their next threshold

```{python}
near = (df[df["next_threshold"].notna()]
        .assign(progress=lambda d: d["signatures"] / d["next_threshold"] * 100)
        .sort_values("progress", ascending=False)
        .head(10)
        .sort_values("progress"))

fig = px.bar(
    near, x="progress", y="short_title", orientation="h",
    custom_data=["signatures", "signatures_to_go", "next_threshold"],
    labels={"progress": "% of the way to next threshold", "short_title": ""},
)
fig.update_traces(
    marker_color=BLUE,
    hovertemplate="<b>%{y}</b><br>%{customdata[0]:,} signatures<br>"
                  "%{customdata[1]:,} to go to %{customdata[2]:,}<extra></extra>",
)
fig.update_layout(xaxis_range=[0, 100], height=460, margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10),
                  plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)")
fig.show()
```

## How many petitions reach each stage

```{python}
bands = df.groupby("signature_band").size().reset_index(name="petitions")
bands["signature_band"] = bands["signature_band"].str.slice(3)   # drop the "1. " sort prefix

fig = px.bar(bands, x="signature_band", y="petitions",
             labels={"signature_band": "", "petitions": "Open petitions"})
fig.update_traces(marker_color=BLUE, hovertemplate="%{x}: %{y:,} petitions<extra></extra>")
fig.update_layout(height=340, margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10), plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)")
fig.show()
```

## Top 15 by signatures

```{python}
top = df.sort_values("signatures", ascending=False).head(15).copy()
top["Petition"] = '<a href="' + top["url"] + '" target="_blank">' + top["short_title"] + "</a>"
top["Signatures"] = top["signatures"].map("{:,}".format)
top["Response?"] = top["has_response"].map({True: "Yes", False: ""})
HTML(top[["Petition", "Signatures", "Response?"]].to_html(index=False, escape=False,
                                                          classes="table table-sm"))
```

*Data: [UK Parliament petitions](https://petition.parliament.uk/), Open Government Licence v3.0.*
